title: Interactive Slide Dispositions
description: Make all slides interactive by default: every disposition is hoverable, selectable (click + rectangle marquee with crossing/window rules), draggable, resizable, with per-disposition slide-fullscreen toggle. Ephemeral in-session only.
summary: Removed slide-edge clamping on drag: translateDispositionRect no longer caps x/y; pointer mapping during drag uses unclamped section fractions so elements follow the cursor anywhere on the slide. Added overflow:visible on interactive sections for off-slide placement.
